RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, so sex cannot explain why she was chosen over you. Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and damage your professional reputation.

The firm explicitly cited her "excellent client relationships," indicating they prioritized commercial acumen and client management alongside technical credentials. Leadership roles often favor business development over additional years of technical design experience. If any bias existed, age might be a theoretical concern given your fifteen years of experience versus her eight, but there is no evidence of that. 

Send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how to strengthen your profile for future leadership roles, without mentioning gender.
